span.p:
CrowdStrike Detection
Alert Ingested by Sumo
Logic SOAR

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Parse Alert Fields: Host,
User, Process, Hash, Action

span.p:
Is Process or Hash in
Trusted or Allowlisted
Software?

span.p:
Was CrowdStrike Action
Block or Quarantine or Kill?

span.p:
